note: Phase 1 = the 737-800 outside. Rows are ordered by recommendation. Sketchfab downloads require a logged-in Sketchfab account, so Brook downloads the glTF zip in his browser into raw/models/<id>/; build-index records the sha256. CC BY 4.0 attribution = creator name, link to the model, licence name with link, and a note that the work was modified (repainted, rigged, compressed). All three are rendered in the credits block and stored in credits.json.

rows.author: hakai315
rows.title: B737-800 Model
rows.evidence: description: 'With landing gear, Detailed, No animation'; white blank finish; 35 likes, 13k views; no livery to strip
rows.concerns: provenance unstated (no 'made in' credit, uploader has no other aircraft); UVs unknown until inspected; mesh separation unknown (a rig needs gear, flaps, spoilers, control surfaces as separate nodes, else they are split by bounds or cut in Blender)
rows.modified: repainted to the AXZ livery with authored PBR textures, rigged to rigs/b738.json, Draco-compressed, KTX2 textures

rows.author: icr343
rows.title: Boeing 737-800
rows.evidence: description states Fusion 360 CAD, 'Separated components for easy customization'; blue nacelles and fin, no airline marks
rows.concerns: CAD origin usually means no UVs and dense flat-shaded tessellation; description reads as marketing copy
rows.recommendation: FALLBACK if the primary has no usable UVs or mesh separation; evaluate both zips before choosing

rows.author: someone353
rows.title: B737-800 Blank Livery
rows.concerns: no description at all; the least detail of the three from its thumbnail
rows.recommendation: SECOND FALLBACK; evaluate only if both above fail inspection

rows.author: Google (Draco)
rows.concerns: Apache-2.0 is not yet in the allowlist (decision D12)

rejected.author: manilov.ap

rejected.author: outpiston
rejected.why: CC BY-NC-SA: not in the allowlist
identical face/vertex counts under two accounts, one with a name unfit to print: a re-upload of unknown origin
JAL livery; description is copied airline prose, not a model description

rejected.author: taeemtasbi
rejected.why: a real 737 flight-deck interior, but 1.75M faces, no textures, no description, no tags, no provenance; near-identical face count re-uploaded by sanjujain960 in 2026-04. Usable only as reference, not as an asset

decisions: D12 add Apache-2.0 (and MIT) to the licence allowlist for kind=decoder rows
D13 exterior: sourced CC-BY geometry + authored PBR skin (recommended), or the spec's D2 authored loft; decide after inspecting the primary zip
D14 cockpit: no acceptable CC source exists; build it (spec §7) as `authored`, using the taeemtasbi thumbnail only as a visual reference
D15 the credits gate gains required `authorUrl`, `source` link and `modified` note for CC-BY rows (a stricter gate, not a looser one)
